## What changed?

Describe the product change, affected packages and feature IDs.

## Evidence checklist

- [ ] Added/updated automated tests for behavioral changes (or justified why not).
- [ ] `npm run build` passed.
- [ ] `npm test` passed.
- [ ] `npm run features` run and generated `docs/docs/features.md` and tags committed.
- [ ] `npm run features -- --check` passed.
- [ ] Updated `docs/features.yaml` when feature behavior, status, tests or refs changed (or explained why unchanged).
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and examples (or explained why not applicable).
- [ ] Updated relevant package `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes (or explained why not applicable).
- [ ] Evaluated API/BPMN XML, data migration, security, backward compatibility and delegate impact.
- [ ] Reviewed diff for unrelated changes and secrets.
